patthana16.23:2.1: kusalaṃ bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana16.23:4.1: abyākataṃ upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana16.23:5.1: kusalaṃ no upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na no upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi, nava.
patthana16.23:6.1: abyākataṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, abyākataṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. abyākataṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na upādinno ca na akusalo na upādinno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
